# `mcp_broker_backend`

Selects the broker-staged backend cluster for an MCP handshake subrequest.

## Configuration Notes

Generated by the `mcp` broker for `backend_sessions`; operators do not configure it directly. Requests without a staged cluster, or with a cluster outside the configured list, fail closed.

## Configuration

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|---------|-------------|
| `clusters` | string[] | yes | Clusters this selector may assign. |

## Example

```yaml
filter: mcp_broker_backend
clusters: [weather-mcp, calendar-mcp]
```
